messages:
leah-fin: Heads-up: QuantumStack (acct QS-112) has overdue invoice `INV-2026-305` for $18,750. Dunning 1 sent, no reply. Thoughts on a soft hold vs payment plan? @omar-am @anjali-collections

omar-am: I pinged their AM — CFO is traveling. They asked if we can accept a two-pay split: $9,000 now, $9,750 in 30 days, and keep Dedicated uninterrupted.

anjali-collections: Collections policy: we can allow a short split but need signed amendment + cleared initial payment. Recommend require card on file + suspension if second payment missed after 7 days. No fee waivers without exec approval.

noah-legal: I can draft a short amendment with auto-charge fallback and suspension triggers. Who will handle signature collection?

omar-am: I'll coordinate signatures. Client offered to wire initial payment today and will email SWIFT.

leah-fin: Invoice details: `INV-2026-305` issued 2026-03-10, due 2026-04-09, amount $18,750. Proposed schedule in amendment: $9,000 immediate, remainder 2026-05-09. Remove $150 late fee conditional on full compliance.

anjali-collections: Add clause: if initial payment not cleared within 3 business days, auto-escalate to suspension. Also require finance@redwood-inference.com gets POP.

payments-bot: Notice: automated retry on stored card (ending 4321) scheduled for 2026-04-12T07:00:00Z.

cfo: Conditional approval for $150 fee waiver if initial payment clears and amendment is signed within 72 hours. Finance to confirm cleared funds before removing fee.

noah-legal: Drafted amendment and uploaded link: https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-305/amendment. Tagging for signatures.

omar-am: Client sent SWIFT remittance receipt at 2026-04-11T14:20Z. Uploading now. Will ask them to sign amendment today.

leah-fin: Ill mark `INV-2026-305` as "payment plan pending" and hold external escalation while initial payment is in transit. Finance to update ledger when funds clear.

anjali-collections: Noted. If second payment misses, escalate to collections after 7 days suspension window.

omar-am: Will report back once funds post. Thanks. :thumbsup:
